name: audio_sfx_generate
description: AI sound-effect generation (ElevenLabs). Short non-musical audio: footsteps, impacts, UI clicks, ambience, weapon and creature sounds. For songs or scored music use `audio_music_generate`; for spoken lines use `audio_tts`.

durationSeconds.description: 1-30 seconds. Billing scales with duration; one-shot effects usually need 1-3.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

loop.description: Ask for a seamlessly looping clip. Default false. Use for continuous ambience (rain, engine hum), not for one-shots.

prompt.description: Sound description, max 450 chars. Name the source, the surface and the perspective ("single footstep on wet gravel, close mic"), not a musical style.

promptInfluence.description: 0-1; how literally the prompt is followed. Default 0.3. Ignored when `variations` > 1, which sweeps the value across the takes.

variations.description: 1-4 alternative takes of the same prompt, billed separately. Default 1. Use it for effects that repeat in-game (footsteps, impacts) so they do not sound identical.
